summary: Direction: better than the national position - the oldest and deepest regional framework in Spain. Ley 2/2014, an integral law for non-discrimination on grounds of gender identity, was among the first trans-specific regional laws in Europe; Ley 8/2017 of 28 December (in force 4 February 2018) guarantees LGTBI rights and equal treatment for LGTBI people and their families; and the regional government approved an equality strategy for 2024-2028 on 26 December 2024. Visitor-relevant geography: Andalucía carries much of Spain's LGBTQ mass tourism (Mijas, Torremolinos, Seville), which coexists with school-content opt-out ('pin parental') conflicts that historically concentrated in Andalusian municipalities.

Criminal-law firm analysis (June 2026) disentangling Spain's 2023 reform: what Organic Law 4/2023 does and does not do; the Penal Code Article 22.4 aggravating circumstance for bias motivated by gender identity or expression; and the Article 510 hate-offences provision extended to trans and LGBTI people - with the practical sentencing consequence of each.
